fields.question: How do I submit an expense?
fields.answer: To submit an expense, go to the Expenses page and click 'New Expense'. Fill in the details including amount, date, category, and attach a receipt. Then click Submit for approval.

fields.question: How long does approval take?
fields.answer: Typically, expense approvals are processed within 2-3 business days. Managers receive notifications when new expenses are submitted for their review.

fields.question: Can I create a report for multiple expenses?
fields.answer: Yes! You can generate custom reports from the Reports section. Select the date range, filter by category or department, and choose your preferred format (PDF, Excel, or CSV).

fields.question: How do I book a business trip?
fields.answer: Go to the Trips section and click 'New Trip'. Enter your destination, dates, purpose, and estimated expenses. Once submitted, your manager will review and approve the trip request.

fields.question: How do I reset my password?
fields.answer: On the login page, click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your email address and you'll receive instructions to reset your password. Follow the link in the email to create a new password.
